filesystem.description: Read, write, and search the workspace. Backs repo-analyzer's Read/Grep/Glob needs on engines without native file tools.

shell-commands.description: Execute shell commands. Backs verifier's Bash need (npm/pnpm/yarn test, lint, build) and repo-analyzer inspection commands.

fetch.description: Fetch web documentation. Used to resolve Node.js/TypeScript framework questions against official docs.

github.description: OPTIONAL vendor-agnostic extension. Repository, issue, PR, and code search. Requires a GitHub PAT in your environment.
